messages:
Sara K: quick sanity check — ran the new ranker v2-compact on the current holdout and seeing a weird split: MRR +0.6% but NDCG@10 down ~1.8%.
Miguel R: hmm. is that across all cohorts or concentrated in long queries? :thinking:
Sara K: looks concentrated in mid-length queries (6-16 tokens). Short queries fine. Also noticed the candidate ordering in our eval harness differs from prod: we include `title` before `body` in the doc concat for eval.
Priya S: did you use PTQ int8 for v2-compact or FP16? quant can change ranking ordering sometimes (especially near ties).
Sara K: PTQ int8 — same config we used last week for other models.
Miguel R: can you paste the eval command + config? I want to check preprocess flags.
Sara K: sure — running snippet I used:
```
python eval_rerank.py --model v2-compact --ckpt runs/v2c/ckpt.pt --holdout holdout_v3.jsonl \
  --preprocess "concat:title|body|meta" --tokenizer lower_case=False --batch 128 --quantize int8
```
Jeff L: ah — tokenizer lower_case=False stands out. Our golden eval for previous models used lower_case=True to match production normalization. That could cause subtle tokenization differences and tie-break shifts.
Priya S: also check `meta` placement. If we include metadata keys like `source`, `published_at` before text it can bias the attention and change top-k order for near-ties. For the holdout we usually strip `published_at` for relevance evals.
Sara K: ok — will try two reruns: (A) tokenizer lower_case=True, keep quant int8; (B) remove metadata fields from concat.
Miguel R: add a control (C) same as A but run in FP16 to see if quant is amplifying the delta.
Sara K: will do. ETA ~45m.
deploy-bot: new eval job queued by Sara K — job id eval-6843210000-1.
Priya S: if C shows FP16 reduces NDCG drop, then PTQ fine-tuning / calibration might fix it. If not, likely formatting/metadata.
Jeff L: FYI I dug up a small example where title contains date prefix that the model treats as stronger signal when it appears before the body. Example (holdout sample):
```
{
  "query": "how to renew subscription",
  "doc_a": "2024-07-01 - Subscription renewal guide...",
  "doc_b": "Subscription renewal guide..."
}
```
When `doc_a` kept the date token at the front it moved up in ranking for some models.
Sara K: good catch. I’ll add a quick preprocessing pass removing ISO dates at head.
Miguel R: can you also dump tokenized lengths for the affected queries? helps confirm if casing/tokenizer boundary causes collisions.
Sara K: yep — will attach token dumps to the job.
Priya S: ping me when jobs finish, I can run calibration sweep (per-layer bias correction) if quant seems to be the root cause.
Sara K: thanks — will follow up in thread with results. :thumbsup:
